changelog_text:
## Changes
- Tessera loads again on KSA 2026.11.16.5901. The game moved the minimum throttle of an engine from the combustion chamber to the rocket, so Mizar and Mizar Fixed did not load with 1.0.0. The minimum throttle (10 percent) is the same as before.
- Part Ids, shapes, colliders and masses are unchanged, so saved vehicles load as before.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.16.5901**. Needs this build or newer; on 2026.11.10.5801 use the previous version.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineTessera\`.
No mod loader needed.

listing.name: Tessera by Purrline Rocketworks
listing.abstract: A modular lunar lander kit: decks, wall and solar panels, a thrust cone, a core column, sphere, capsule and drum tanks, the Mizar descent engine, landing legs and a lattice ramp that deploy.
listing.description:
![A lander built from Tessera parts](ksa-image:hero)

**Tessera** is a modular lunar lander kit for Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**. Build a robotic lander the size of the real ones, from a small hopper to a cargo lander, out of decks, panels, tanks, engines and legs that snap together at their edges.

## Parts

The kit has 18 parts with 38 variants.

- **Tessera Hex Deck** and **Oct Deck**: the floors of a lander, with seats for tanks and engines and six or eight edges for panels; open or closed.
- **Tessera Wall Panel**, **Half Panel** and **Taper Panel**: walls and skirts in isogrid, skin, radiator, gold foil and silver foil looks; wall and half panels have leg pads at their lower corners.
- **Tessera Solar Wall Panel** and **Solar Half Panel**: walls of solar cells, 420 W and 210 W.
- **Tessera Thrust Cone**, **Core Column** and **Deck Strut**: the structure under and between the decks.
- **Tessera Sphere Tank**, **Capsule Tank** and **Drum Tank**: Methalox tanks in bare, gold blanket and silver blanket looks; the sphere also as a carbon bottle.
- **Mizar** and **Mizar Fixed**: the descent engine, 3.1 kN, with a gimbal or on a fixed mount.
- **Tessera Landing Leg** in a short and a long form, and the **Tessera Lattice Ramp**: they deploy from the part menu.

Each part is one entry in the editor; press V to change its variant. Masses count the structure only, so add a stock probe core and a battery. The tanks hold the true volume of their shape, so a stock tank of the same size holds about four times as much.

![All parts and looks](ksa-image:all-parts)

![A tall hex lander](ksa-image:tall-lander)

![A wide octagonal cargo lander](ksa-image:wide-lander)

![Seven Mizar Fixed in a Thrust Cone, from below](ksa-image:engines-below)

The landers in the pictures were built in the editor from these parts; the mod contains no vehicle files. Some of them carry payload parts of Facet by Purrline Rocketworks.

## Requirements

No other mod needed.

## Install

- Borea: install Tessera from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineTessera` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.16.5901.

Code and game data are MIT. Meshes, textures, logo and pictures are CC BY 4.0.
